en: This black-and-white postcard is divided into four sections, showcasing both the exterior and interior of a historic church. The top-left panel displays an outside view of the church, characterized by its Baroque or late Gothic steeple and an onion-shaped dome, common in Central Europe. The top-right and bottom panels exhibit the ornate interior, featuring classic church pews, a central altar, an elaborately decorated pipe organ, and a pulpit gallery with floral adornments and coats of arms.
